marks.gloss_en: ולימא ויאמר אל תקרב הלם? -- and let him say 'do not come near' (Ex 3:5)!
Rav Acha breih deRava: rather, the first day Ex 3:2 with 3:3, the next day 3:4, the next day 'do not come near' (3:5)

Rav Huna: for tertian fever, bring seven thorns from seven palms, seven slivers from seven beams, seven pegs from seven bridges, seven ashes from seven ovens, seven dusts from seven door-sockets, seven pitches from seven boats, seven cumin seeds, seven hairs from an old dog's beard, and bind them at the neck-opening with a hair thread
R' Yochanan: for burning fever, take a knife made wholly of iron, go where there is a bush, and tie a hair thread to it
R' Yochanan: on the first day notch it a little and say 'an angel of the Lord appeared' (Ex 3:2); next day 'Moses said, I will turn aside' (3:3); next day 'the Lord saw that he turned aside' (3:4)

and when he cuts it, he stoops, cuts it, and says: the bush, the bush -- not because you are higher than all trees did the Holy One rest His presence on you but because you are lower; and as the fire saw Chananya, Mishael and Azarya and fled, so may the fire see so-and-so son of so-and-so and flee

for boils (סימטא) let him say: Baz, Bazya, Mas, Masya, Kas, Kasya, Sharlai and Amarlai, these angels sent from the land of Sodom ... so may you not be fruitful nor multiply in the body of so-and-so son of so-and-so
for a wound (כיפה) let him say: a drawn sword and a readied sling; its name is not Yokhav; sickness, pains
for a demon let him say: you were stopped up, stopped up you were; cursed, broken and banned be bar Tit bar Tamei bar Tina...
for the demon of the privy let him say: on the head of a lion and the snout of a lioness we found the demon bar Shirika Panda; with a bed of leeks I felled him, with a donkey's jaw I struck him
R' Meir: one may go out [on Shabbat] with a locust egg
רבי שמעון היא, דאמר: כל ישראל בני מלכים הם -- the clause is R' Shimon's, since he holds all Israel are princes
the mishna: and princes [may go out on Shabbat] with bells
כדתניא: וטמא טמא יקרא -- he must make his pain known to the many, and the many will ask mercy for him
כי היכי דליחזיוה אינשי וליבעו עליה רחמי -- the paint does serve: people see it and ask mercy for the tree (= p_sikra_rachamim)
the stam: [the red paint is] so that people will see it and ask mercy for it
והתניא: a tree that sheds its fruit -- one paints it red and loads it with stones. בשלמא the stones weaken it; but the red paint, what healing does it do? -- yet the baraita permits it
the stam: then [by implication] what has no [element] of healing does have [an element] of the ways of the Amorite?
Abaye and Rava: anything that has [an element] of healing has no [element] of the ways of the Amorite
R' Chiyya bar Avin: all of them [in the Amorite chapter] have [an element] of the ways of the Amorite, except these
R' Chiyya bar Avin: for a fish-bone let him say 'you are stuck like a needle, locked like a shield; go down, go down'
the locust egg [of the mishna]: that they use it for shichla
